Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly assumed the column name in the Excel file would be "Daily Excursion," and did not verify this assumption before moving forward with task delegation. The error cascaded, as subsequent agents (specifically Coder) were tasked with writing and executing a Python script based on incorrect assumptions about the column names in the dataset. This mistake aligns closely with Example 1 (Case #66), where unvalidated assumptions about a file structure or data format led to errors and unnecessary cycles to identify the problem.
